name: Tropical leaf–wood TLS
limitations: Leaf/wood geometry reference; retain official train/test splits.

name: BCI tropical TLS + QSM
attributes: Separate leaf/wood point clouds; repeated QSM fits
limitations: Leaf and wood files represent the same tree; QSM replicates are not additional trees. Record links no specific paper; paper attribution unresolved.

name: Quebec hardwood MLS + destructive reference
attributes: LAZ; QSM; destructive volume; DBH; field measurements
limitations: Join by native Tree ID. Associated manuscript named in Readme.docx; publication DOI not supplied by current record.

name: HuashuTrees
attributes: Paired leaf-on/leaf-off; field traits; labelled attributes
data_license: dataset license not specified in API; verify source terms
limitations: Do not count both seasons or sample/full-release overlap twice. Article license does not establish dataset license.

name: Demol destructive validation TLS
attributes: Clean scan clouds; QSM; destructive biomass/density
limitations: QSM is measured-scan reconstruction of wood. Archive MAT file count is not a tree population count.

name: EucFACE individual trees + QSM
published_count: 116 trees in associated study; release membership needs inspection
attributes: Individual tree clouds; QSM; analysis code
limitations: Distinguish paper analysis population from all released files.

name: Wytham Woods
attributes: PLY scan clouds; optimal QSM; analysis
limitations: Download PLY once; TXT is another representation of the same trees. Study boundary exclusions explain count difference.

name: TreeML-Data
attributes: Point clouds; QSM; graphs; transforms; tree/QSM attributes
limitations: 40 urban survey projects; graphs and QSM are companion derivatives. Keep original coordinate transformations.

name: BioDiv3DTrees
attributes: Scan clouds; species labels; QSM; graphs
limitations: TLS/ULS and derivatives may overlap by tree. Large QSM archive is lower download priority; do not add counts across representations.

name: FOR-species20K
limitations: Aggregates other datasets: cross-source overlap must be checked. Crown/branch completeness varies. Test species labels withheld. Dev metadata contains Weiser_2022a (226), Weiser_2022b (2580), Calders_2022 (661), likely linked to SYSSIFOSS/Wytham; tree-by-tree identity matching pending.

name: Central European segmented TLS trees
attributes: Leaf-on/off scans; measured traits; structural metadata
limitations: Only SEGMENTED_TREES belongs to measured library. Exclude 273 procedural foliage reconstructions and 15718 simulated ALS scenes. Seasonal clouds are not necessarily distinct trees. Acquired subset and full ZIP overlap; retained release-file bytes include both, not independent observations.

name: SYSSIFOSS / PyTreeDB source collection
published_count: source releases across 12 forest plots; no aggregate unique count claimed
attributes: Matched scan modalities; traits; acquisition metadata
limitations: PyTreeDB indexes these sources; it is not an independent measured population. Select detailed TLS trees for geometry, preserve matching ULS/ALS as validation.

name: TreeScanPL10K
acquisition: TLS plot clouds with tree IDs
published_count: paper: 10417 trees / 7465 species-labelled; released summary: 10447 unique source-file/treeID rows / 7468 labelled; 272 plots
limitations: Select completelyInside=1 for uncropped crowns; plot boundary flag does not guarantee absence of scan occlusion. Must extract by plot + treeID. Paper and released table counts differ; no explanation inferred. Released summary has 9525 rows with completely_inside=1.

name: IRLTrees3D
species: mixed trees; source also contains other objects
limitations: Project endpoint unavailable during check. Include only tree objects and distinguish photographs/mesh/3DGS; no automatically verified data yet. ICCVW 2025 paper available.

name: Shivalik Himalaya leaf–wood lidar
limitations: File access restricted. User must request/download through official access mechanism; paper is open. Source lookup resolved to version record 17566270; original requested record 15362444 retained as source pointer.

name: Järvselja measured conifer shoots
limitations: Organ-level geometry only; cannot be counted as complete trees. Helpful for needle/shoot reference.

name: TreeLearn real forest benchmark
published_count: 156 manually annotated benchmark trees; 6665 automatically labelled training trees
attributes: Instance segmentation labels; raw plot clouds
limitations: Separate manual benchmark from automatic pseudo-labels. Source data: https://doi.org/10.25625/VPMPID and https://doi.org/10.25625/QUTUWU . Paper preprint arXiv:2309.08471.

name: DigiForests
published_count: longitudinal plots; no unique tree count claimed
attributes: Stem/crown and instance labels; repeated surveys; field traits
limitations: Repeated observations of the same plots are not new trees. Project research document saved; bibliography of data release papers needs completion.

name: TreeScope
limitations: Stem detection reference, not an assured whole-crown library. Associated paper arXiv:2310.02162.
